Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the very first step by incorrectly concluding that *My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy* (2010) was released under Roc-A-Fella Records. While the album was released by Def Jam and GOOD Music, Roc-A-Fella had dissolved and ceased operations years prior (officially ending around 2013 but effectively inactive for major releases by 2010). The album *My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy* does not satisfy the "Roc-A-Fella Records" constraint. The correct answer is *Graduation* (2007), which was released under Roc-A-Fella/Def Jam and features Dwele on the track "Flashing Lights." This initial hallucination regarding the label for *MBDTF* led the entire conversation down the wrong path, causing the agents to ignore the correct album (*Graduation*) and fixate on the wrong one (*MBDTF*), even though *Graduation* fits all criteria.
